meta.name: persona-definer
meta.description: Identify and prioritize buyer personas at the contact level for outbound targeting. Use when asked "who should I email", "define buyer persona", "what role to target", "who is the decision maker", "who has this pain", "which title to reach out to", "should I target VPs or Directors", or "contact-level targeting". Use AFTER ICP is defined (ICP = which companies, Persona = which person at those companies).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别并优先排序目标买家联系人角色
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做B2B外呼时需要确定该联系哪个角色
copy.tagline_en: Identify and prioritize buyer personas for outbound targeting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide which contact role to target in B2B outbound

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会询问你的产品、价格等信息，生成 2-4 个潜在买家角色，再评分排序，最终输出前两个角色的完整卡片，包括头衔、痛点、决策角色、沟通渠道等。
howto.when: 当你问“我应该给谁发邮件”、“定义买家角色”、“谁是决策者”等联系人级别的问题时触发。使用时需先定义好 ICP（目标公司）。

say.text: 定义买家角色：我们的 CRM 售价 1 万/年，谁最可能买？
say.note: Claude 会收集信息并输出角色假设。

say.text: 我应该给谁发邮件推销一款数据分析工具？
say.note: Claude 会启动角色定义流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask for your product and price information, generate 2-4 buyer persona hypotheses, score and rank them, then output full persona cards for the top two, including titles, pain points, decision role, and channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'who should I email', 'define buyer persona', 'who is the decision maker', or similar contact-level targeting questions. Requires ICP (company-level) to be defined first.

say_en.text: Define buyer persona for our CRM priced at $10k/year. Who is most likely to buy?
say_en.note: Claude will collect info and output persona hypotheses.

say_en.text: Who should I email to sell a data analytics tool?
say_en.note: Claude will start the persona definition process.
